Describe the defect, expected behavior and reproduction steps.

Include plugin, PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce and official Stripe extension versions; order storage mode (legacy/HPOS); authentication method; and the safe error code.

Do not include merchant keys, Application Passwords, cookies, nonces, order keys, payment URLs, client secrets, customer data or raw provider responses. For a security issue, follow SECURITY.md instead of opening a public report.
